courses.title: The 10 Types of Rest Every Woman With ADHD Needs
courses.description: A self-paced class from Tanya in 19 steps on ten kinds of rest, what tends to get in the way of each, and how to make room for them in a way that suits a busy, distractible mind. It comes with course notes, guided meditations for rest, a private discussion forum and a closing self-check quiz, with a certificate on completion.

left_out: Coaching/mentoring listings under ADHD, anxiety, menopause, sleep and related filters: on https://www.restinhispresence.com/courses these are only filter labels; the page lists no coaching or mentoring programme of its own (only the two classes, one already listed), so there is nothing to restore.
flags: 10 Types of Rest: names ADHD (a condition) and says its meditations help 'soothe fatigue'; no claim to cure or treat, so kept under the 12 Nov rule.
Price shown as '$19.99' with no currency code on the page; copied as published.
